---
title: "Condition errors"
format: html
filters:
  - git-sandbox
---

The options here are well-formed, so the exercise renders — but two of the
conditions cannot be read. Those tasks should say so in place.

```git-sandbox
id: broken-conditions
title: Broken conditions
tasks:
  - text: This one is fine
    when: repo
  - text: This condition has a typo
    when: frobnicate
  - text: This condition is incomplete
    when: commits >=
  - text: This one uses the js escape hatch
    js: c.isRepo === false
```
